kpis.name: Overall role readiness %
kpis.question: What share of required capability does the function have today?
kpis.definition: What share of required capability does the function have today
kpis.formula: weighted avg role readiness % (H3/M2/L1) across employees
kpis.benchmark: No public benchmark found (INFERENCE: set client-specific target)

kpis.name: Critical gap exposure
kpis.question: How many high-priority requirements are unmet?
kpis.definition: How many high-priority requirements are unmet
kpis.formula: count(ratings where priority=H and level<required)

kpis.name: Bench strength ratio
